description: Unlock a domain and get its transfer auth code, to move it to another registrar. When applied, the code is in the result (shown once; owners get a notice). Not possible within 60 days of a registration or transfer. Applies at once when you act for an owner or admin and the workspace lets agents apply changes (the default); otherwise it waits in list_approvals. workflow.state says which.
name: request_auth_code
title: Request a transfer auth code
